expectation: SocratiCode will find at least one gold location for most queries (recall@10 >= 0.8) but completeness will be much lower for multi-location concerns (mean completeness@10 perhaps 0.4-0.6), because top-k chunk search is not an exhaustive enumerator.
criteria: Sealed 32-query set (gap12_queries.json, sha256 recorded before indexing) with exhaustive pattern-defined gold over scripts/*.py at 41d39b3 (176 locations).
SocratiCode 1.14.0 against a disposable Qdrant; codebase_search limit 10, minScore 0.
A gold line counts as recovered at k when a top-k chunk has the same file and its line range contains the line.
Report hit@5/@10, MRR, mean completeness@5/@10 and fully-complete@10 fraction; list per-query misses.
